notes: CORTEX recall reads `findings`, which nothing populates yet: consolidation (03 §4.4) is changefeed-driven and not built. Every recall in this arm therefore returns 0, while the NAIVE arm reads its own local note store and returns real hits. The comparison understates CORTEX on the three recall-dependent tasks; it is not corrected here, because inventing a findings writer would mean benchmarking a mechanism that does not exist.
